nodes.label: Impairment corrodes judgment rather than quickening reactions

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-F02 says the opening rehearsal item teaches that alcohol and drugs corrode judgment rather than quickening reactions, while sec12-R01 restates that impairment never quickens reactions or sharpens focus; learners pick the distractor that alcohol speeds reactions

nodes.label: A dashed yellow line on your side opens passing on your side only

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-F03 says a dashed yellow line on your side alone opens passing on your side only, while sec12-R02 restates that your-side dashes never open both directions; learners think a dashed line on one side allows passing in both directions

nodes.label: Twin four-way arrivals yield to the right-hand driver

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-F04 says twin arrivals at a four-way stop yield to the right-hand driver, while sec12-R03 adds that neither plowing through nor bowing left is correct; learners yield to the left

nodes.label: Two picture items quiz sign reading

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

nodes.label: Regulatory signs wear white, not green or yellow

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-F06 says regulatory signs wear white, not green or yellow, while sec12-R04 contrasts white regulation with yellow warning and green guide; learners pick yellow for regulation

nodes.label: Jaywalkers still command a stop

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-F07 says mid-street jaywalkers still command a stop despite their illegality, while sec12-R05 adds that horns and dismissals are wrong; learners honk at jaywalkers

nodes.label: Motorcycles own a complete lane

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-F08 says motorcycle operators own a complete traffic lane, while sec12-R06 restates never a shared lane or the shoulder; learners share a lane with a motorcycle

nodes.label: Cyclists earn slow speeds and maximum room

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-F09 says cyclists earn slow speeds and maximum passing room, while sec12-R07 restates never horns or hurried squeezes; learners honk to pass a cyclist

nodes.label: High beams belong to empty roads only

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-F10 says high beams belong to empty roads and never to fog, rain, snow or followers, while sec12-R08 says storms and followers take lows; learners use highs in fog

nodes.label: Impairment never quickens reactions or sharpens focus

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-R01 restates that impairment corrodes judgment, while sec12-F02 ties that lesson to the opening rehearsal item; learners confuse the rehearsal lesson with its distractors

nodes.label: Your-side dashes open your side alone

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-R02 says your-side dashes open your side alone, while sec12-F03 states the dashed yellow line rule; learners think both directions may pass

nodes.label: Yield right, never plow through or bow left

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-R03 says twin four-way arrivals yield right rather than plowing through or bowing left, while sec12-F04 states the yield-to-the-right rule; learners yield to the left

nodes.label: White regulates against yellow warning and green guide

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-R04 contrasts white regulation with yellow warning and green guide, while sec12-F06 states that regulatory signs wear white; learners confuse guide green with regulation

nodes.label: Jaywalkers command stops, never horns or dismissals

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-R05 says jaywalkers command stops rather than horns or dismissals, while sec12-F07 says their illegality does not remove the duty to stop; learners dismiss jaywalkers because they are breaking the law

nodes.label: Whole lanes, never shares or shoulders

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-R06 says motorcycles own whole lanes and never shares or shoulders, while sec12-F08 states the complete-lane rule; learners push motorcycles to the shoulder

nodes.label: Slow room for cyclists, never honks or squeezes

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-R07 says cyclists earn slow room rather than honks or squeezes, while sec12-F09 states the slow speed and maximum room rule; learners squeeze past cyclists

nodes.label: Highs for empty roads; storms and followers take lows

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy), not an exam weight

source_ref.ref: Kentucky Driver Manual Updated 7-23-26 pdf p.80

confusable_with.why: sec12-R08 contrasts highs on empty roads with lows for storms and followers, while sec12-F10 lists fog, rain, snow and followers as the no-high cases; learners keep highs on behind another car
